theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (T : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ R : ℝ, ⨆ j, (T j).massOn (ball (0 : Euclid P) R) < ∞) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), StrictMono φ ∧ WeaklyConvergesOn (fun i => T (φ i)) C
